data.headline: Co-Founder, building something new | QA Engineer | Open to QA Contract Opportunities
data.about:
I’m a seasoned QA Engineer with strong experience in mobile and web testing. Over the past X years, I’ve helped teams deliver reliable, user-focused software through a mix of test automation, hands-on testing, and process improvement.

Alongside this, I’ve stepped into entrepreneurship as the Co-Founder of Glamora Aesthetics—a forward-thinking beauty and wellness startup. At Glamora, we don’t build machines ourselves—we curate and utilize the best AI-powered, automated technologies in the industry. From nail printing systems to smart massage devices, we identify the most innovative tools available and bring them together to create high-quality, accessible beauty experiences.

While I’m excited about scaling Glamora, I also remain open to QA contract opportunities. I enjoy collaborating with teams that value quality from day one, and I’m especially effective at setting up robust test practices, mobile automation frameworks, and QA strategies that help products succeed.

Let’s connect—whether you’re interested in QA consulting, contract roles, or in exploring the future of beauty tech.

WANU is UK-based professional employment consultancy that provides job security, employee benefits, and takes the hassle out of self-employment. Freelancers with WANU have an employee contract with us, so they don’t have to struggle setting up a limited company, registering as self-employed, or opening a business bank account. We take care of contract negotiation and invoicing. And we pay you monthly.

Are you interested in joining WANU? Send me a message today!

·  HUD Platform Architecture: Spearheaded quality assurance for a high-traffic, gambling-based poker tracking web application featuring a real-time Heads-Up Display (HUD) that integrated seamlessly across major online poker platforms to track live player statistics and math overlays.
 
· Player-Advocate UI/UX Validation: Acted as the primary quality advocate for the player experience, performing live table testing to guarantee that real-time game state data was accurately detected from active poker tables and perfectly synchronized with the graphic HUD overlays, interactive UI elements, and statistical data tables

· Production Support & Defect Resolution: Acted as a key quality advocate providing critical production support, taking full responsibility for reproducing, testing, and re-testing live production defects to guarantee high-quality player usability and software reliability.

End-to-End Test Coverage: Designed and executed thorough end-to-end testing strategies spanning Functional, Regression, Installation, GUI, and Usability testing to evaluate intricate interface layouts and cross-application functionality beyond simple Pass/Fail states.

QA Documentation & Test Packs: Authored comprehensive industry-standard STR (Software Test Report) and STD (Software Test Description) artifacts, while building robust, repeatable Sanity and Regression packs to safeguard core feature stability.

Defect Prevention in Agile: Collaborated closely with developers and product teams in a high-velocity Agile/Scrum environment with daily software releases to identify system defects early in the cycle.

Technical Traffic & Data Validation: Utilized Fiddler for capturing and analyzing live network traffic, executed SQL queries via Navicat for database validation, and drove agile releases using Jenkins.
